book.name: Pilimoni
book.title: PILIMONI Pilimoni ꞌina leta Paulo ꞌileleya

content: Loyauwedo

Yauwedo tasigu Pilimoni, ꞌowa Yesu Keliso ꞌina topaihowa ꞌaigeda, gide taugu. Ma taugu Paulo deliya boꞌi silagugauwa Yesu Keliso ꞌina paihowa weyahina, ma bewa Timoti ꞌiꞌabihetegau ta bewa ꞌino leta ꞌaleleleleyawa.

Ma ꞌima helau mabwaiyami ꞌoimiya, ꞌowa ma nuhudai Apiya ma tasidai Alikipo, tauna baꞌidada tahehetapewa Yesu Keliso ꞌina paihowa weyahina, ma wete ꞌima helau tohekalesiyao mabwaiyadi taudi ꞌino hada silolotapwalolo ꞌoidiya.
Cida Bada Yesu Keliso ma Tamada Yehoba ꞌidi helauwega tuwa wamiya yaliyaya.
Pilimoni mumugana bwebweꞌana

Wasau yahesagoha pwaiya beno ꞌino helau ma ꞌino hemisa ꞌida Bada Yesu ꞌoina, ma ꞌana tomuliyao mabwaiyadi wete ꞌoidiya, ꞌoinega tuta mabwaiyana ꞌigu ꞌahwanoi ꞌoidiyega maꞌigu loyauwedo, Yehoba ꞌoina weyahiu.
Nuwanuwagu ma ꞌida heꞌiyaꞌiyagu Keliso ꞌoinega ꞌida ꞌabihewaiwaiyego ma wete ginaula mabwaiyadi bwebweꞌadi Keliso ꞌoinega silatulatuma ꞌuda sanapudi.
Tasigu, ꞌino helauwega tohekalesiyao ꞌuꞌabihetediya ma ꞌadi lotohona ꞌiꞌabihe bwebweꞌaneya, ma ꞌino helau ta wasau bwebweꞌana yahesagoheya, ta yayaliyaya madouna.
Paulo nuwanuwana ma Pilimoni ꞌida tagwale Onesimo ꞌoina

Nuwanuwagu ma helauwega ginaula ꞌaigeda ꞌupaihowa. Taugu Paulo, ꞌino bada, ma deliya yamiyamiya Yesu Keliso weyahina, ꞌoinega sawasawahigu ma Keliso saninega yaloinego ma ginaulaina ꞌupaihowa, ma tuwa hesi, helauwega yahegwaego,
beno yaꞌahwanoiyego natugu Onesimo weyahina, tauna ꞌima miya deliya ꞌoinega yaꞌahwa natuneya, ꞌina hemisa Keliso ꞌoina weyahina.
Mwalo loheyaina Onesimo ꞌino paihowa ꞌoiuwa geya bwebweꞌana, ma bewa ꞌinuwabuiya ta ꞌina paihowa ꞌoiguwa bwebweꞌana, ma wete yasanapuya mumugana weyahiu ꞌibwebweꞌana pwaiya.
Coinega Onesimoina yahesumana hileyawa, ta maꞌigu nuwagala,
weyahina nuwanuwagu yanuwahi ma tauna ꞌihesuwahego ma ꞌiꞌabihetegau ꞌigu miya deli ꞌoina.
Ma nata geya yanuwanuwahi, weyahina ꞌowa ꞌana toloina. Ma wete nuwanuwagu ꞌino tagwala ꞌoiguwa helauwega ꞌupaihowa ma sahena ꞌigu heꞌiꞌima ꞌoinega.
Nuwana bewa tauna huhuna ta Onesimo ꞌiꞌebesinegowa tuta muhemuhena tuwa, ma ꞌeguma ꞌihilawa nata baꞌidau wamiya hataya.

Mwalo tauna ꞌino topaihowa, ma sauga bewa geya ꞌabehega ꞌihetopaihowamo, ma tauna wete taꞌahwa tasine Yesu Keliso ꞌoinega. Tauna boꞌi yaꞌahwa tasineya, ma ꞌowa ꞌilobwainegowa ma ꞌuꞌahwatasina moisa, weyahina tauna ꞌino topaihowa ma wete tasiu ꞌida Bada ꞌoinega.
Pilimoni ꞌowa ma taugu taꞌahwa tasineya, ꞌoinega ꞌagu helau ꞌoiuwega, ꞌeguma yahapwesawa, gide wete Onesimo ꞌutoehila.
Toꞌaha gide mwalo ꞌina pui, nana ꞌana haga ꞌulagu, ꞌabwa taugu yahemaise.
Taugu Paulo bewa nimaguwega yalelelele ꞌabehega mabwaiyana yahemaise hegumwali. Ma hesi sahena ꞌa haga ꞌoiguwa weyahina yagwaegwae, beno mwalo taugu ꞌigu paihowega ta yaluyaluwau ꞌiꞌehau pwaiya.
Cae tasigu, nuwanuwagu ma Keliso saninega Onesimo ꞌuhelauwe, ma ꞌina pui ꞌunuwasam, beno ꞌabihetena madouna ꞌoiguwa, ma ꞌane ꞌagu lotohona ꞌibwebweꞌana mabwaiyana.
Cigu nuwatuhu bewa yaleleyawa, maꞌigu hemisa ma ꞌabehega ꞌigu gwaeyedi ꞌuhesagohedi, ma ꞌumuliyedi, ma wete ꞌuꞌabihemadou.
Ginaula ꞌaigeda wete nuwanuwagu, beno ꞌigu ꞌebeꞌeno ꞌino hada, ꞌuꞌatububu, weyahina yanuwatuhuya ꞌabehega ꞌino ꞌahwanoi Yehoba ꞌoina ꞌoinega ma muhemuhena ma deliyega silihasigau ta yatauyawa ꞌoiuwa.
Epapila baꞌidagu Yesu Keliso ꞌina paihowa weyahina ta deliya silagumaiya, ma Epapilaina ꞌina helau ꞌoiuwa.
Gide wete taudi baꞌidagwao ꞌapaipaihowa: Maki ma Alisitako ma Dimasa ma Luke, ꞌidi helau wete ꞌoiuwa.
Cida Bada Yesu Keliso tuwa yaluyaluwau ꞌihehelauwe ma ꞌumiya bwebweꞌana. Taugu Paulo.
